proved: 15 actual HTTP requests per version executed by historical EpharmApiClient/TaskKioskClient/FulfillmentClient on an in-process loopback listener.
Exact method, path/query, synthetic key header names/values and JSON body match versioned golden fixtures.
Both versions parse current-shaped recommendation/playlist/update/CDP/task/fulfillment JSON; additive recommendation stock/source fields are ignored safely.
No Authorization/Cookie/X-Staff-Session is attached. 1.0.57 task GET omits X-Device-Id;1.0.66 includes it.
notProved: Listener is synthetic, not Spring; server authorization, persistence, timeout/ingress and device binding are not proved by this .NET test.
Success status or decoded playlist does not prove popup, QR or video frame rendered.

proved: Legacy cart, saleId/pharmacy/session/sourceDocumentId/qty/printedAt/fiscal-null payloads decode using current C# models.
Current recommendation decoder retains additive stock/source fields; both historical decoders tolerate them.
notProved: Kotlin Bean Validation, Jackson and database effects require sibling backend contract tests; no actual business sale or credit was created.

proved: Actual historical clients return null/false on mock401 for recommend/sale/shown without requiring human login or emitting bearer credentials.
notProved: Mock401 does not verify the real per-device credential lookup or legacy-key exception.

proved: 1.0.57 treats task available:false as an empty result;1.0.66 throws MerchTaskUnavailableException.
Both ACK implementations return false on accepted:false/available:false.
Both TaskKioskClient.ListAsync implementations return a task with past dueAt and future expiresAt, so backend deadline filtering must remain.
Both preserve legacy first-party query-token links and CRM fragment-token links byte-for-byte as QR URLs.
notProved: Neither historical version has the later durable DPAPI QR-shown outbox; pending visible-window retry and real token generation need Windows/composed tests.
Historical WPF TaskKioskWindow independently checks expiresAt before announcing display. The ListAsync test is not proof that an expired QR would be rendered.

proved: 1.0.57 CanIssue permits paid-card and demo-no-charge examples;1.0.66 and current client restrict non-demo pickup/cash.
Golden action carries expectedVersion, six-digit code and explicit cashCollected; fulfillment uses separate X-Fulfillment-Device header.
notProved: Server must retain its own scope/version/payment/code guards; permissive legacy UI cannot authorize money or order issue.

proved: Both historical verifiers accept an ephemeral synthetic P256-signed manifest generated from current canonical bytes.
Missing pin and tampered URL/hash/version/platform/mandatory are rejected.
Canonical signed fields remain LF-separated platform/version/url/lowercaseSHA256/mandatory, DER ECDSA-SHA256.
notProved: Installed public pin, archive hashes/bytes, real HTTPS and actual updater application/restart/config retention were not exercised.

proved: Historical typed sale JSON survives SQLite enqueue/reopen/reschedule and duplicate stable-ID enqueue in the current queue; delivery removal leaves no pending record.
OfflineOutbox, OutboxFlusher and SaleReport sources have no diff between these legacy commits and baseline.
notProved: Existing device databases, actual pending fiscal/shown/outcome backlog and real financial idempotency after migration require isolated restore/server tests.

proved: Golden fixtures pin https://epharm.inkar.kz; current configuration retains that HTTPS URI.
Current staff-auth release constant remains false; old request flows contain no staff login dependency.
notProved: Historical configuration was deliberately replaced by a test adapter; installed DNS/TLS/config and actual absence of an RPS window require Windows verification.

legacyUpdateException.behavior: Only app/version uses authenticateForUpdate with allowLegacyKey=true while ordinary device operations use the legacy-enabled flag. Retain this narrow path for credential-migration updates; do not re-enable the fleet key globally.

deviceBinding.behavior: Current controller accepts absent X-Device-Id on task GET for1.0.57; key still binds pharmacy, and supplied device/pharmacy claims must match. Fulfillment keeps its separate token header.

behaviorByVersion.1.0.57: Recommendation shown is enqueued from WPF Loaded; it lacks the later native topmost/geometry display proof.
behaviorByVersion.1.0.66: Recommendation shown follows Displayed after native topmost, visibility and target-screen geometry checks.
behaviorByVersion.both: HTTP200/heartbeat/recommendation generation and task polling are not evidence that a human saw a popup or QR.

customerDisplay.behavior: MainWindow.Screen and MediaCache are identical between these two version-entry commits;playlist DTO URLs/order/duration are decoded by tests. 1.0.66 adds Standard-N window-based pharmacist monitor selection and separates customer display from it. Actual media download/playback and monitor routing are not executed.

behaviorByVersion.1.0.66: Healthy jitter24..36 seconds, bounded failure backoff up to5minutes; separate from core recommend/heartbeat/sales.

requiredWindowsAndRestoreChecks: Establish installed EXE/package hashes and source provenance for each supported1.0.57/1.0.66 build; no version-only assumption.
Use synthetic transactions on isolated Windows/Standard-N: scan->recommendation overlay on pharmacist screen at supported DPI/monitors; scanner focus and cleared/replaced receipt handling.
Verify1.0.57 Loaded acknowledgment limitation explicitly; capture real overlay/native proof separately from backend shown timestamp.
Verify customer display plays exact intended cached media on the second screen; HTTP200/playlist decode/monitorCount are insufficient.
Verify actual current/legacy QR, query/fragment links, due/expiry/revision/revocation, visible-only ACK and behavior after network loss/restart; old versions lack durable QR-shown queue.
Restore per-device pharmacy binding, credential hashes, pending SQLite outboxes and common database IDs; prove repeat sale/shown/outcome/action/financial callback does not duplicate effects.
Verify pinned HTTPS origin, ingress/TLS, signed public download Range/resume and independently pinned installed ECDSA key; keep old-key exception strictly on version route.
Keep RPS/staff windows disabled; no new requirement to sign in before Standard-N core workflows.
overallReadiness: K1 local source/wire evidence improved; real installed-client/Windows/composed-backend compatibility remains pending. Not deployment approval.
